notes.title: Update v0.5.5 - New Celestial Bodies, A Tutorial, Updated Help Menu, And More!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I'm finally back with the first big update since we've become a studio, and this is a massive one! The new gameplay changes adds tons of new cool strategies, and the overall gameplay should be much more stable now that we've fixed a lot of long-standing annoying bugs! As always, I hope you all enjoy the update, and let me know if you run into any issues! 

Added new 5 new celestial bodies! Each of them has certain specialties, or new mechanics, surrounding them, which are:

Red Giant: A massive star that produces lots of energy but very few ships

Asteroid Cluster: A collection of asteroids which is great at mass-producing ships, but has very little energy production and ship capacity

Gas Giant: A planet that has a very large ship capacity and hides the number of ships inside of it from other players, but has poor production

Neutron Star: A unique star that has very high energy and ship production, however is unable to build any defenses at all

Black Hole: A mysterious phenomenon that has very little production, but destroys 50% of all enemy ships that touch it

Added a setting to adjust the rate of these new celestial bodies, so that you can still play "vanilla", or so that you can make the galaxy completely chaotic

Added a few achievements for the new celestial bodies

Implemented an actual tutorial! Let us know if you break it or just if you have any general feedback on it :)

Massively improved the help menu (it's useful now AND looks good!)

Implemented a new galaxy shape and matching achievement (Eclipse)

Hopefully finally fixed a long-standing bug with ships pathing incorrectly/weirdly, please let me know if you still see any unintended behavior!

Made the game play nice with (hopefully) any resolution. Let me know if you have a non-standard monitor size and still run into any issues! (also, the placeholder resolution setting was removed since your resolution should automatically be detected)

Fixed a bug where ships sometimes got stuck inside/on the edge of planets

Slightly nerfed the ship cap for large planets (350 -> 300)

Made energy sync much better in multiplayer, allowing us to re-enable defensive platforms consuming energy in multiplayer games

Fixed the "Preferred color" setting not working in multiplayer

Fixed an unreported long-standing bug with settings not saving sometimes

Fixed the "ships decaying" icon showing up at the start of games when it shouldn't

Made ships a bit bigger to fix a new issue where they would sometimes accidentally "miss" other ships when going through a hyperlane

Loadssss of smaller bugfixes and QoL changes!

P.S. I recently discovered that the game actually plays pretty well on the steam deck, give it a shot if you have one! I might make it fully compatible in a future update!

notes.title: Update v0.5.1 - Multiplayer Fixes and Debugging Reports
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, just a small update for now to address many of the issues that players have encountered with the new multiplayer! After this update we'll focus on polishing multiplayer some more, before we finally move on to the next major content update, which will add new planet types and stars which will all have unique mechanics associated with them! I hope you all enjoy the fixes that come with this update!

Added a way to investigate what's causing the multiplayer delay issue. If you run into the issue, then before you start another game, type %appdata% into your windows search bar, press enter, and then go to Godot -> app_userdata -> Relentless Expanse. In that folder, you'll find a file called "lastGameReport.dat". Just create a bug report, post that file, and we'll take it from there! Every report helps us narrow down the issue, so we greatly appreciate everyone that's able to help us with this!

Fixed neutral pop multiplier not working properly in multiplayer

Fixed buy ships not working in multiplayer

Fixed an issue in multiplayer where repeat send commands weren't being cancelled properly whenever a planet was taken over

Temporarily removed trading. This will be reworked and then added back at some point in the future, however for now it's too buggy and is almost never used by players

Fixed various smaller issues relating to multiplayer

notes.title: Update v0.5 - The Long-Awaited Multiplayer Update!!!
notes.notes:
Wow, this one has been a VERY long time coming, hasn't it? Well, it's finally here! You don't have to worry about being limited to just 3 servers or about servers randomly crashing or going offline, you can create your own lobbies, and you can directly invite your friends through steam! This one took a LOT of code, both adding new code and changing old code, so we're really excited to finally have it out!



With the release of this update, Relentless Expanse finally feels like it's in a fairly stable position, although there's certainly plenty of aspects that can and will be improved upon. Also, we can now start working towards more ambitious updates that change up the gameplay in fun and unique new ways! We'll tease more about updates in the future if they start taking too long, so be sure to join our discord here:



https://discord.com/invite/ZjaBnbDVcU



Also, as always, and for this update especially, keep an eye out for any bugs that may have slipped through the cracks! We playtested this one more than we normally do, but it's definitely not perfect (defensive platforms still don't cost energy to fire in multiplayer, although this will be fixed soon), and this update changed a LOT of code, so even though it shouldn't change singleplayer gameplay at all, it's possible that it introduced some new bugs for it.



P.S. Keep an eye out for a MASSIVE announcement within the next few days that will heavily effect the future of Relentless Expanse! I hope you all enjoy the update :)

notes.title: v0.4.8 Hotfix + Defensive Platform Energy Cost Rework
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I've got lots of good changes and fixes for you all here, including a rework of how the defensive platforms calculate the cost per shot! First, let me go over some of the bug fixes and changes:


 Halved the speed of decay when planets are above the ship cap
 Adjusted AI numbers a bit to make sure they don't get stuck in niche situations where they get stuck trying to take over planets
 Fixed planetary defense not shooting in multiplayer (apparently this was related to them not being able to see how much energy players have, which unfortunately wasn't an easy fix, so while they still shoot, they won't be able to consume any energy for now)
 Fixed some issues with earning/not earning the new achievements
 Several other minor fixes that I forgot to note


Now, let's get to the real fun bit: planetary defense now costing energy per shot. This was met with mixed reactions, and I think fairly so. It certainly makes energy more valuable, however it disproportionately effects smaller empires, making it easier for larger empires to take advantage of that and further snowball. So, to counter this, I've come up with an interesting system that should hopefully address and fix both issues. I've introduced a (currently invisible) system called "empire points".

Basically, each planet and each defense upgrade level is worth 1 empire point. The more empire points you have, the more energy each turret shot costs. Additionally, players/AI with 5 or less empire points don't have any cost for their turret shots. These values are very much subject to change, but for now this is how they look:

10 Empire Points = ~0.5 energy per shot
25 = ~1 energy
50 = ~2 energy
100 = ~3 energy

The cost caps out at about 4 energy no matter how big the empire gets. This seems like quiet a bit, however by that point you will probably control most of the planets in the game, so it really shouldn't be as bad as it seems. Let me know how you all feel about this system! I think I'll need to adjust the numbers some more, but hopefully you all find it much better than before!

notes.title: Update v0.4.8 - New Achievements, New Galaxy Shapes, Reworked Systems, And More!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, here's another update to help tide everyone over until the multiplayer rework! There's some pretty nice changes and fixes in here, so let me know what you all think about it! Good luck relentlessly expanding! (that sounds a little weird... oh well)


 Added 12 new achievements!
 Added 2 new galaxy shapes and a new "random" option that randomly selects from every galaxy shape
 Reverted some changes for AI so that they're much more aggressive again (and not so "slow" to react)
 Reworked defensive platforms so that they now consume 1 energy for every shot. This change has two main purposes: To make energy more valuable, and to slightly nerf defensive platforms. I'll be monitoring feedback on this change closely to see whether or not it lands well with players, so let me know your thoughts on it!
 Planets now decay much quicker whenever they're very far above their cap
 Spruced up the main menu with some fun extra visual stuff
 Added a preview in the settings menu for the preferred color options
 Added visual and audio feedback for whenever a player purchases ships
 Made it so that a message is sent in chat which tells you how many planets (and to what level) were upgraded whenever you mass-upgrade
 Fixed an issue where AI were, apparently, not gaining any energy from their starting planet!
 Fixed a bug where typing in chat or other input boxes could trigger keybinds
 Several other smaller QoL changes and bugfixes

notes.title: Update v0.4.7 - Galaxy Shapes, AI Update, Key Rebinds, And More!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, it's been a bit, here's a big update for you all! The multiplayer update has been taking longer than expected, so I wanted to push out another update in the meantime! I hope you all enjoy :)


 You can now choose the shape of the galaxy that you want to play in! There are currently 7 options, and more can be easily added in the future, feel free to suggest new shapes!
 Heavily adjusted the decision-making for AI, they will now do a LOT of things differently, explore the new AI and let me know if you find any weird new behaviors!
 Added the ability to change keybinds in the settings
 You can now right-click on any empty space when you have planets selected and choose to mass-upgrade the selected planets
 Added a "preferred color" option in the settings (only works in singleplayer for now, will work in multiplayer after the multiplayer update!)
 Adjusted pathfinding some more - the vast majority of the time it will act intelligently and path around neutral and enemy planets, however it may still do some weird pathfinding sometimes. Let me know if the pathfinding is better this way!
 Defensive Platform radius colors will now be shown as red if they belong to an enemy, and you will see a preview of the range of the defensive platform if you hover over the purchase button for defense
 Added OpenGL as a launch option for users with GPUs that can't run Vulkan
 Lowered the 5x speed option to 4x speed to help prevent some performance issues and other bugs that could occur at high speeds
 Ships can now be "culled" if there are too many on the screen at once, to help prevent bad performance issues later in the game. Only ship sizes of less than 5 can be culled, and when a ship is culled the health it had will be returned to a random planet belonging to its faction
 Fixed a bug where only 1 defensive platform would be destroyed if the planet was taken over at defense level 2, instead of destroying both defensive platforms
 Fixed a bug where all of your planets would be deselected when one of your planets got taken over, instead of just the planet that was taken over
 Fixed an issue where ships wouldn't collide with newly taken over planets if they were inside of the planet's hitbox when it was taken over (also known as ship-juking)
 Several other small QoL changes and bug-fixes

notes.title: Update v0.4.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
I've got a pretty big update for you all today which comes with a LOT of fixes and new features that were requested! However, I would first like to address the state of multiplayer. The connection is inconsistent at best, and there are a lot of multiplayer-specific bugs and issues that haven't been fixed yet. The bad news is that these issues require basically a full rewrite of all of the multiplayer code. The good news is that we've been working on fixing it for a while now and have been making great progress! We expect to begin playtesting the new multiplayer system soon, and we'll bring it to the public build as soon as we're able to! In the meantime, I hope you enjoy the update!


 Added the ability to pause the game in singleplayer (you can also press space to toggle it, and it will auto-pause the game when you open the escape menu now)
 Added the ability to speed up or slow down the game in singleplayer (press 1 for 0.5x speed, 2 for 1x speed, 3 for 2x speed, and 4 for 5x speed)
 Added a button and keybind (Q) to toggle all of your defensive platforms on or off, and added individual buttons for every planet so that you can toggle the defensive platforms for specific planets
 Added a button and keybind (E) to toggle the visibility of the range of defensive platforms
 Added a "Buy Max" button to the "Buy Ships" UI
 Replaced the placeholder "Gift Ships" button with a "Send Num" button that allows you to send an exact amount of ships (ships can be "gifted" through the trading mechanic anyways)
 Added 2 new icons to planets that appear whenever the planets are repeatedly sending or losing ships
 Ship pathfinding has been reverted to an earlier version that is now more "intelligent" (they'll generally try to avoid suiciding into neutral or enemy planets), however it may also be more unpredictable and weird, let me know which pathfinding you guys prefer!
 Made the colors of players and AI more visually distinct
 Chat is now hidden by default and is only shown if a message has been sent recently or if you're typing a message
 Implemented missing assets for "Buy Ships" UI
 A couple minor QoL features
 Several small bug fixes

notes.title: v0.4.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Just a quick hotfix for some issues that were introduced in the last update! Here are the changes:


 Fixed an issue where planets weren't able to stop their continuous send orders in multiplayer
 Fixed a minor bug where 1 ship would get subtracted from player planets at the start of every game (inconsequential but very annoying)

notes.title: Update v0.4.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Before I get to the patch notes, I just wanted to say thank you to everyone for the massive amount of support! I expected almost no one to play the game, but so far over 650 people have played and I've received a huge amount of positive support and feedback! So, here's an update that addresses some of the main issues that everyone has been facing so far:


 Added 2 new servers to play on!!!
 Optimized ships a LOT, it should be very difficult to crash the game or get less than 30 fps now, let me know if you’re still having issues after this update! Benchmark tests showed an increase from ~5 to ~40 fps when repeatedly sending ships from every planet on a max size galaxy. Here are some of the optimization changes you’ll notice in the gameplay:
 Repeatedly sending ships from planets now waits until there are at least 3 ships before they are sent out, I know this is a bit annoying but the performance payoff is really big!
 Ships will now only send as a single ship from each planet instead of spawning in groups of 1, 5, 25, etc.

 Hopefully fixed the bug where players would disconnect for seemingly no reason, this may cause issues if a player loses connection mid-game so be sure to report any bugs regarding this to me! It will also cause servers to never restart if someone loses connection, so servers will now restart after 30 minutes automatically if it detects that someone has lost connection (this will obviously still cause servers to close prematurely sometimes but a 30-minute delay is much better than instantly!)
 Every planet now has 3 small numbers to the right of it to display their levels so that you don’t need to select a planet to see what its levels are
 Players and AI will now try to spawn at least 3-4 planets away from other players and AI when possible
 Probably fixed the bug where negative numbers would sometimes show on planets
 A few other minor bug fixes and QoL improvements
